coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available; trial registries, regulatory sources, preprint servers, patent and chemistry databases, dedicated genetic-variant databases, GWAS catalogs, and citation-graph services are outside scope.
PubMed-only routing may miss full-text-only terminology, non-indexed conference material, very recent unreviewed work, and backward or forward citations absent from PubMed metadata.
Population allele frequencies, clinical variant classifications, and locus-level association fine-mapping cannot be comprehensively validated against dedicated genomic resources.
Publication-date indexing can lag online-first release; the cutoff must be reapplied during screening and date provenance retained.
Physiological-substrate evidence may remain model-, tissue-, perturbation-, or variant-specific, limiting generalization to dopaminergic neurons and sporadic Parkinson disease.
exclusion_criteria: Records that mention LRRK2 or Parkinson disease without evidence relevant to genetic discovery, variants, enzymatic mechanism, physiological substrates, or mechanism-limiting findings.
Purely computational predictions lacking genetic, biochemical, cellular, structural, animal, or human validation.
Studies centered on unrelated kinases, Rab proteins, or parkinsonian disorders without an explicit LRRK2 relationship.
Secondary summaries used as sole support when an identifiable primary study is available.
Duplicate canonical records, while preserving every query-to-record occurrence and linkage to corrections or retractions.
inclusion_criteria: Publication date on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first and issue dates recorded separately when available.
Primary human genetic studies linking LRRK2 loci or variants to Parkinson disease, including linkage, sequencing, association, ancestry-specific frequency, segregation, and penetrance evidence.
Biochemical, structural, cellular, animal, or human-tissue studies directly evaluating LRRK2 enzymatic activity, variant effects, substrates, phosphosites, or downstream physiology.
Reviews and meta-analyses retained for terminology expansion and citation discovery, with decisive claims traced to primary records.
Negative, null, replication, correction, and retraction records relevant to the strength, specificity, or generality of the proposed mechanism.
Studies in any organism or experimental system when their model, tissue, cell type, perturbation, and relevance to human disease can be stated explicitly.
Records in any language when sufficient PubMed metadata or an accessible abstract permits eligibility assessment; language limitations are documented during screening.

queries.purpose: Validate core target and disease terminology and recover primary genetic and mechanistic anchor records.
queries.query: ("leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR "Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract] OR "Parkinson's disease"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve linkage, gene-identification, and early mutation reports underlying the genetic discovery.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract]) AND (linkage[Title/Abstract] OR "positional cloning"[Title/Abstract] OR discover*[Title/Abstract] OR mutation*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence on major disease-associated coding variants, segregation, frequency, penetrance, and phenotype.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture common-risk alleles, population-specific variants, association studies, and penetrance estimates.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract]) AND (GWAS[Title/Abstract] OR "genome-wide association"[Title/Abstract] OR "risk variant"[Title/Abstract] OR G2385R[Title/Abstract] OR R1628P[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm variant-dependent effects on LRRK2 kinase and ROC-COR GTPase functions.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR "ROC-COR"[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441*[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR pathogenic[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify proposed and validated Rab-family substrates and the assays supporting direct phosphorylation.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ((Rab[Title/Abstract] AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphor*[Title/Abstract])) OR Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR Rab29[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm physiological substrate status using endogenous phosphosites, genetic models, pharmacological perturbation, and orthogonal validation.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("physiological substrate"[Title/Abstract] OR phosphosite[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR knockin[Title/Abstract] OR "knock-in"[Title/Abstract] OR inhibitor[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab*[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Expand from enzymatic substrates to downstream organelle and trafficking phenotypes.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (lysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR endolysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR autophag*[Title/Abstract] OR vesicle*[Title/Abstract] OR cili*[Title/Abstract] OR mitochondri*[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract] OR phosphor*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Test tissue, cell-type, and organismal scope of the proposed mechanism.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (neuron*[Title/Abstract] OR microglia[Title/Abstract] OR macrophage*[Title/Abstract] OR kidney[Title/Abstract] OR lung[Title/Abstract] OR brain[Title/Abstract]) AND (expression[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphor*[Title/Abstract] OR phenotype*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve negative findings, failed replications, conflicting results, corrections, and retractions affecting major claims.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND (negative[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR discordant[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR "failed to replicate"[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Publication Type] OR retracted[Publication Type])

queries.purpose: Find evidence limiting extrapolation across carriers, variants, sporadic disease, experimental models, species, and cell types.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND ("incomplete penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR "variable penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR sporadic[Title/Abstract] OR "loss of function"[Title/Abstract] OR knockout[Title/Abstract] OR "species difference"[Title/Abstract] OR "cell type"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR mechanism*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture recent genetic, substrate, mechanistic, and counterevidence publications through the delivery cutoff.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab*[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract])) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: through 2024-12-31, trace how human genetics connected LRRK2/PARK8 to Parkinson disease, distinguish highly penetrant pathogenic variants from risk-associated variants, define kinase and ROC-COR GTPase mechanisms and physiological substrates, and assess human, cellular, biochemical, and animal evidence that supports or limits causal generality across variants, tissues, models, and sporadic disease.
stop_rules: Execute no more than the 12 specified PubMed query events.
Complete every planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update query.

Confirm recovery of primary evidence for initial genetic discovery, at least one high-impact pathogenic variant, LRRK2 enzymatic activity, and at least one physiological-substrate claim; revise terminology within the fixed query budget if a checkpoint is absent.
Stop expansion after two consecutive expansion events add no new decision-relevant primary evidence or mechanistic counterevidence.
Stop when additional retrieval cannot change the brief's conclusions about genetic causality, variant-specific mechanism, substrate support, or limits of generality.
Report budget exhaustion, unresolved anchor checkpoints, unavailable source classes, and temporal-indexing ambiguity as limitations.
